summary: Validated the Grid Evolution Expo WebView wrapper and Play Store packaging. Wrapper layout renders correctly on the Expo web preview (mobile viewport 375x667): SafeAreaView mounts, dark #121212 background, loader (testID='grid-evolution-loader') is visible at startup and disappears after the 4s fallback timer, parent container (testID='grid-evolution-webview-container') is present. The inner WebView shows 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' on web — this is the known react-native-webview web stub behavior and is explicitly out of scope per the agent-to-agent note (real Android device required). No console errors. app.json is correctly configured for Play Store (package=com.dinzdp.gridevolution, versionCode=3, version=1.0.2, orientation=portrait, zero requested Android permissions, full blockedPermissions list, adaptive-icon + splash referenced). All PNG assets exist (icon 46KB, adaptive-icon 35KB, splash-icon 14KB, favicon 1KB). gameHtml.json decodes to 422,876 bytes (~423KB) of valid HTML starting with '<!doctype html>'. Store metadata (description_tr.md, description_en.md, privacy_policy.md, data_safety.md) and /app/memory/PRD.md all present.

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-webview shows 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' fallback on web; expected per agent_to_agent_context_note — does NOT affect Android Play Store build, which uses the real native WebView. No fix required.

action_items: MINOR: /app/memory/PRD.md states 'versionCode / buildNumber: 2' but app.json correctly uses versionCode=3 (and iOS buildNumber=2). Update PRD line 15 to '3 / 2' to match shipping config.

OPTIONAL: A deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' appears in Metro logs. The loader View already uses style.pointerEvents, so the warning likely originates from react-native-webview's web stub or SafeAreaView internals — non-blocking and does not affect Android.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx: Pure-JS base64 decoder uses unescape/escape via decodeURIComponent(escape(latin1)) — these are deprecated globals but still work in RN/Hermes. Acceptable for offline single-shot decode at module load.
index.tsx: Fallback timer is 4s while review request mentions 5s — current 4s is stricter and fine; loader hides via onLoadEnd OR 4s timer.

Back-button handler sets exitingRef synchronously to true on first press, so the IF guard at top of onBack means a second hardware back press will fall through to default OS exit — works in tandem with the Alert. Logic is correct.
All interactive/loading elements have testID. Wrapper uses View/Text/ActivityIndicator (no raw HTML).
seed_data_creation: None required (offline app, no backend, no DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a single-screen offline WebView wrapper for Play Store. NO backend. Do NOT attempt to play the 2048 game inside the WebView via web preview — react-native-webview returns a placeholder on web. Validate wrapper layout + app.json + assets only. Real game playback must be tested on an Android device or Android emulator after EAS Build / Emergent Publish.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. The visible 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' text on web is the documented react-native-webview web fallback, not a defect.
